dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) targeting a screen-based ATM application; uses COB_SCREEN_EXCEPTIONS environment variable, SCREEN SECTION with BACKGROUND-COLOR/FOREGROUND-COLOR, CRT STATUS, and indexed file with VALUE OF FILE-ID — all characteristic of GnuCOBOL

purpose.domain_detail: ATM (Cajero Automatico) balance inquiry module for a fictional UnizarBank; reads indexed transaction file to find latest balance for a given card number
purpose.summary: This subprogram accepts a card number (TNUM) via LINKAGE SECTION, opens an indexed file of bank transactions, scans for the most recent transaction matching the card, and displays the current balance on a terminal screen. It handles the case of no prior transactions and shows an error screen on file I/O failures.

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with color attributes (BACKGROUND-COLOR, FOREGROUND-COLOR)
CRT STATUS / keyboard function-key detection (PGUP, PGDN, arrow keys)
LINKAGE SECTION parameter (TNUM) — called as subprogram
SET ENVIRONMENT for GnuCOBOL screen exceptions
INDEXED file with DYNAMIC access and FILE STATUS
GO TO used for flow control (6 occurrences)
verdict.notes: Program appears to be a student project (UnizarBank likely references Universidad de Zaragoza). Spanish comments and UI text. No COMP-3, no SQL, no CICS. Fixed format confirmed by max line length <=72 and mechanical indicator. The PERFORM IMPRIMIR-CABECERA THRU IMPRIMIR-CABECERA pattern is unusual but valid in GnuCOBOL.
